en: The Mañjuśrī Stotra: The glorious Lord Mañjuśrī, whose crown jewel rests upon a lotus seat,
is the sovereign of vidyās and the universal monarch of the mandala of the world.
We pay homage to the Noble One, whose gentle form is adorned by the excellence cultivated through meditative absorption, and who is venerated by gods, humans, and asuras. || 1 ||
Having the form of a youth, with hands as radiant and tremulous as blue lotuses, his cheeks brushed by armlets, necklaces, gems, and earrings; he,
possessing a delicate form, was devouring the sixteen autumns.
We pay homage to Mañjughoṣa, who is worshipped by the best of gods. || 2 ||
O Lord, O ocean of virtues, by means of your mantra of the three knowledges, the manifestation of the entire universe revolves within the pore of a single hair on the Sugata’s son.
Salutations be to that son of the Buddha, who is subtle. || 3 ||
Established happily in the path of the profound method of Dharma,
an ocean of gnosis that brings benefit to all sentient beings,
an immeasurable sea of qualities and a treasury of wisdom—
I constantly pay homage to Mañjuśrī, the Son of the Conqueror. || 4 ||
He who has realized all truths, who dispels the suffering of sentient beings, who benefits the three worlds, who removes all misery,
the heroic subduer of Madana, beautiful in form, and clad in fine rags—
May Mañjughoṣa, who brings satisfaction to the people of the three worlds, protect me. || 5 ||
I always pay homage to Mañjuśrī, whose radiant appearance is like the crescent moon, who is adorned with excellent ornaments, and whose eyes are like the pure petals of a lotus of wisdom. 6.
I bow to Mañjughoṣa, by whose name there is prosperity everywhere, and in whose left hand a bowl, resembling an añjali-cupped gesture, revolves. (7)
Homage to you, Mañjughoṣa, who holds a sword and a book in your hands, who dwells within the lunar disc, and who is the sun to the darkness of ignorance. (8)
With devotion, I bow down to Jñānottaraprabhāketu, Praṇidhānamati, Śāntendriya, and Mañjughoṣa. (9)
The Praise Hymn to Śrī Mañjuśrī is completed.
